tools.name: get_passage
tools.description: Return the verbatim text of a Bible passage (up to 200 verses) in one public-domain translation, with a citation link. Examples: "John 3:16", "Psalm 23", "Genesis 1:1-2:3", "Esther 4", "Tobit 12", "1 Enoch 1:9".

tools.name: compare_translations
tools.description: Return the same reference side by side in 2 to 6 translations, for example Septuagint and KJV. Default: lxx2012 and kjv. Covers passages where the Septuagint and Masoretic-based Bibles differ (Isaiah 7:14, Psalm 40:6, Deuteronomy 32:43, Esther, Daniel).

tools.name: search_scripture
tools.description: Find verses containing a phrase (case-insensitive substring match) in one translation. Returns up to 50 hits in canonical order with references and links.

tools.name: list_translations
tools.description: List the public-domain translations available, with translator, date, licence reasoning and upstream source.

tools.name: list_books
tools.description: List books in canonical order with chapter counts and which translations carry them, including the deuterocanonical books of the Septuagint.

tools.name: get_daily_post
tools.description: Return the Sovereign Logos daily reading for a date. The default date is today in the given timezone. The response contains post text (a "Good Morning" line, the CHRIST IS KING reading summary, and the reading page URL), the four readings from the one-year plan, and URLs for two branded card images

tools.name: create_verse_image
tools.description: Return JPEG URLs for a verse card that composites verbatim scripture onto a pre-existing static image from the Sovereign Logos artwork library. This tool does not generate images. It draws stored verse text, the Sovereign Logos wordmark, and a QR code over a library background. Backgrounds are chose

tools.name: find_reply_verses
tools.description: Find verses and matching images for a debate or reply. Search by word, phrase, topic or reference (e.g. "mammon", "idols", "false prophets", "Isaiah 7:14"); returns curated topics with anchor verses, a ready verse-image URL for each, and the topic's backgrounds. Topics: mammon, money-changers, only-

tools.name: list_backgrounds
tools.description: Browse the Sovereign Logos background library (about 1,070 biblical images) by keyword, category, mood or reply topic, with preview URLs and the verses each image is tagged for. An id from this list is a valid background argument for create_verse_image.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_daily_post, find_reply_verses, list_backgrounds · Public sink: get_daily_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_daily_post, find_reply_verses, list_backgrounds · Public sink: get_daily_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
